title: Multi-task Neural Diffusion Processes
abstract: arXiv:2510.03419v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural diffusion processes provide a scalable, non-Gaussian approach to modelling distributions over functions, but existing formulations are limited to single-task inference and do not capture dependencies across related tasks. We propose multi-task neural diffusion processes (MT-NDPs), an extension that incorporates a task encoder to enable task-conditioned probabilistic regression and few-shot adaptation across related functions. The task encoder extracts a low-dimensional representation from context observations and conditions the diffusion model on this representation, allowing information sharing across tasks while accommodating variable-sized context sets and preserving permutation invariance with respect to the ordering of context observations. translated_abstract: 神经扩散过程为函数分布建模提供了一种可扩展的非高斯方法，但现有形式仅限于单任务推理，无法捕捉相关任务之间的依赖关系。我们提出了多任务神经扩散过程（MT-NDPs），这是一种扩展方法，通过引入任务编码器来实现任务条件化的概率回归以及跨相关函数的少样本自适应。任务编码器从上下文观测中提取低维表示，并以此表示为条件来约束扩散模型，从而实现跨任务的信息共享，同时支持大小可变的上下文集合，并保持对上下文观测顺序的置换不变性。我们通过合成实验以及两个真实世界应用（涉及风力涡轮机数据和学校考试结果）对MT-NDPs进行了评估。结果表明性能得到了改进。
tldr: 提出多任务神经扩散过程（MT-NDPs），通过任务编码器提取任务表示并条件化扩散模型，实现跨任务信息共享的任务条件化概率回归与少样本自适应。
en_tdlr: Proposes multi-task neural diffusion processes (MT-NDPs), which use a task encoder to condition diffusion models on low-dimensional task representations, enabling task-conditioned probabilistic regression and few-shot adaptation with cross-task information sharing.
